spans.s:
mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Soft, bland.
2 Soft, low, sweet.
3 Beautiful, pleasing, agreeable.
f. (-ला)
A plant: see क्षीरिका.
n. (-लं)
Water.
E.
कुट to be curved, कल Uṇādi affix, and मुट् inserted, formative irregular; or कम to desire, कलच् affix, and उ inserted with conversion.

n. (-कं)
The fibres of the stalk of a lotus.
E.
कोमल soft, कन् added.

n. (-तं)
A pleasing song.
E.
कोमल, and गीत a song; also with कन् added, कोमलगीतकः.

f. (-ता)
Softness, tenderness, agreeableness; also with त्व, कोमलत्वं.
